description: This file is a C source file implementing functions related to reflog expiration and configuration within a Git-like version control system. It includes functions for parsing reflog expiration settings, managing reflog entries, checking object completeness, and handling reflog expiration policies.

methods.name: struct:reflog_expire_entry_option * find_cfg_ent(struct reflog_expire_options * opts,const char * pattern,size_t len)
methods.description: Locates or creates a reflog expiration entry matching a given pattern within the configuration options.

methods.name: int reflog_expire_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Parses and applies reflog expiration configuration settings based on given variables, updating the expiration options.

methods.name: void reflog_clear_expire_config(struct reflog_expire_options * opts)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with reflog expiration entries and resets the options.

methods.name: void reflog_expire_options_set_refname(struct reflog_expire_options * cb,const char * ref)
methods.description: Adjusts expiration settings for a specific reference name based on configured patterns.

methods.name: int tree_is_complete(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a tree object and all its entries are fully fetched and complete.

methods.name: int commit_is_complete(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Determines if a commit object and the objects it references are complete and fully available.

methods.name: int keep_entry(struct commit ** it,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Verifies if a commit referenced by an object ID is complete and reachable.

methods.name: void mark_reachable(struct expire_reflog_policy_cb * cb)
methods.description: Marks all commits reachable from a starting list as REACHABLE, stopping at a given expiration limit.

methods.name: int is_unreachable(struct expire_reflog_policy_cb * cb,struct commit * commit,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a commit is not reachable from the current references, indicating potential eligibility for expiration.

methods.name: int should_expire_reflog_ent(struct object_id * ooid,struct object_id * noid,const char * email UNUSED,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz UNUSED,const char * message UNUSED,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Determines whether a reflog entry should be expired based on timestamp, reachability, and other policies.

methods.name: int should_expire_reflog_ent_verbose(struct object_id * ooid,struct object_id * noid,const char * email,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz,const char * message,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Wraps should_expire_reflog_ent with verbose output for debugging or logging.

methods.name: int push_tip_to_list(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Adds the tip commit of a reference to a list, used during expiration policy calculation.

methods.name: int is_head(const char * refname)
methods.description: Identifies whether a reference name corresponds to HEAD.

methods.name: void reflog_expiry_prepare(const char * refname,const struct object_id * oid,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Prepares the expiration policy context for a specific reference, setting the reachable commit set.

methods.name: void reflog_expiry_cleanup(void * cb_data)
methods.description: Cleans up and clears the expiration policy context after processing.

methods.name: int count_reflog_ent(const char * refname UNUSED,struct object_id * ooid UNUSED,struct object_id * noid UNUSED,const char * email UNUSED,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz UNUSED,const char * message UNUSED,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Counts reflog entries, used during expiration calculation based on total age.

methods.name: int reflog_delete(const char * rev,enum expire_reflog_flags flags,int verbose)
methods.description: Deletes reflog entries for a specific reference, based on expiration policies, with optional verbose output.
